title: Choose the harmed security property
teachingQuestion: Which protection outcome is harmed, and what would demonstrate it is protected?
focalInsight: Identify the failure consequence before selecting the control or test.
caption: Identify the failure consequence before selecting the control or test.

nodes.label: Confidentiality
nodes.decision: Decide who may learn the information and under what conditions.
nodes.failureExample: A correctly delivered report is exposed to an unauthorized reader.

nodes.label: Integrity
nodes.definition: Protect against improper modification or destruction.
nodes.decision: Test whether data remains accurate and complete through authorized changes.
nodes.failureExample: A public transit arrival feed is altered while its service stays online.
nodes.detail: Protect against improper modification or destruction.

nodes.label: Availability
nodes.definition: Provide timely, reliable access for authorized use.
nodes.decision: Set the service deadline and tolerated interruption.
nodes.failureExample: An intact emergency roster cannot be retrieved during an evacuation.
nodes.detail: Provide timely, reliable access for authorized use.

nodes.label: Authenticity
nodes.definition: Establish that the claimed entity or information origin is genuine.
nodes.decision: Validate identity or origin, including the trust binding.
nodes.failureExample: An unmodified message comes from an impersonated sender.
nodes.detail: Establish that the claimed entity or information origin is genuine.

nodes.label: Nonrepudiation
nodes.definition: Provide dependable evidence relevant to a later denial of an action.
nodes.decision: Bind the action to an identity and preserve evidence, context and integrity.
nodes.failureExample: A mutable log with a shared account cannot reliably establish which person approved an action.
nodes.detail: Provide dependable evidence relevant to a later denial of an action.

nodes.label: Security requirements
nodes.definition: State the asset, required property, consequence, accountable owner and measurable expectation.
nodes.decision: Select controls and tests against a specific protection outcome.
nodes.failureExample: “Make the portal secure” gives neither a test nor a measurable acceptance criterion.
nodes.detail: State the asset, required property, consequence, accountable owner and measurable expectation.
